messages:
maria: Heads-up — after today's RBAC tighten for keystore-role:egress we started seeing TLS handshakes fail for several APAC egress proxies. Root symptom: services get 502/handshake_fail from the proxy, proxy logs show KMS decrypt denied. @sec-oncall please triage :rotating_light:

emily: Which KMS key/label is failing? any service example?

sunil: quick log snippet from proxy-042 (ap-southeast-1):
```
2026-03-22T10:02:13Z proxy-042 audit=auth DENY unwrap: key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/egress/cryptoKeys/egress-keystore-v2 labels=[env:prod,team:infra]
reason=permissionDenied principal=svc-account:service-eu@dataplane
```
503 downstream: TLS handshake failure (alert: TLS_ERR_KEY_UNWRAP)
```

ivan: That key label name `egress-keystore-v2` looks correct, but RBAC change removed kms.cryptoKeys.get for role `keystore-unwrapper` in apac. I can check role bindings now.

maria: Ops bot shows the RBAC change landed in the policy push at 09:58 UTC: `policy-diff` attached in deploy.ops. I think we accidentally scoped the binding to `region:eu` only.

ops-bot: deploy/policy-bot: policy-change "restrict-keystore-unwrapper" applied by @sunil at 2026-03-22T09:58:41Z — runbook suggests rollback if production decrypt denies detected.

emily: Quick mitigation idea: add an alias binding to include apac service accounts or roll back the policy. Which is faster?

sunil: rolling back the policy is faster for immediate recovery. Adding per-region grants needs a support ticket with IAM if cross-project. I'll prepare rollback.

ivan: While rollback is in flight, we should hotpatch proxy to fallback to cached prefix KV (if available) to avoid complete outage for low-latency callers. Patch command: `kubectl -n proxy patch deployment proxy --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"keystore-fallback":"enabled"}}}}}'`

maria: Doing rollback now. @ops-bot start change-window and annotate audit.

ops-bot: change-window opened by @maria at 2026-03-22T10:04:02Z for rollback: restrict-keystore-unwrapper -> previous state. Recording: changelist-314159.

sunil: Rolled back RBAC binding at 10:05 UTC. Confirming KMS logs...

sunil: KMS logs now show unwrap success for previously failing principals. Proxy errors clearing.

ivan: Can confirm proxy-042 handshake errors dropped to baseline within 2m. Rolling impacted pods to pick up fallback annotation not needed now.

maria: P0 mitigated — traffic restored. Follow-ups:
- create audit alert for KMS decrypt DENY spikes (threshold: >5/min)
- add integration test to policy CI to catch region-scoped RBAC missing for keystore-unwrapper
- add a KMS key label alias mapping so policy changes can be vetted (`egress-keystore-v2` vs `egress-keystore`)

emily: I'll own the CI test and the audit alert. Putting a pager follow-up on sec-oncall for postmortem doc.

sec-oncall: Acknowledged. Will open incident ticket and schedule 1hr RCA tomorrow. Please attach policy diff and KMS audit logs to the ticket.

maria: Thanks team. Notes: this was RBAC scoping error, exacerbated by no immediate alert on KMS decrypt denies. We should treat KMS unwrap denies as a first-class signal for transit encryption regressions.

sunil: Also proposal: when changing keystore RBAC, run a preflight that queries KMS logs for recent principals and simulates unwraps with `kms.projects.cryptoKeys.testIamPermissions` for each region. I'll draft a proposal.

ivan: +1. Will add a playbook step to the mTLS runbook: verify keystore role grants across regions and add fallback behavior in proxies.

ops-bot: incident/314159 created and assigned to @sec-oncall. All actions logged."
